verdict.rationale: Granola Chat runs inside the product and lets users ask questions across all meetings, a single meeting, or a folder to get instant insights and spot patterns. Recipes save insight prompts for one-click reuse, and the product proactively offers pre-meeting briefs and auto-drafted follow-up emails. One user independently calls it "highly capable at summarisation". Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of Chat's cross-meeting insights and suggestions specifically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.
Chat with your meeting notes to recall meeting details, spot patterns across customer calls, and generate follow-up outputs.
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
Recipes are reusable prompt templates that help you quickly get insights from your meeting notes without typing the same questions repeatedly.
Granola preps you for your meetings overnight. Open your note as you join and you'll see a short brief with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points
After an external meeting, Granola can automatically draft a follow-up email - using context from your transcript, calendar, and past Gmail threads - so you can send it in a couple of clicks.
